title: Declare MeterComponent header
description:
Create Source/GUI/MeterComponent.h only. Declare a juce::Component that renders real-time L/R peak and RMS LED-style meter bars, updated on a capped juce::Timer on the message thread. Meter levels must be supplied via a lock-free or atomics-friendly path from the processor (SPSC/atomics), never by calling into the audio thread from the component.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY Source/GUI/MeterComponent.h.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.h
- Source/PluginProcessor.cpp (peak/RMS or meter level fields from earlier phases)
- Source/GUI/SpectrumVisualizer.h (Timer/FIFO patterns for consistency)
- Source/GUI/ (existing GUI headers)

Header requirements:
- Class MeterComponent : public juce::Component, private juce::Timer
- Public API for the editor to host left/right meters (constructor/destructor, paint, resized as needed)
- setLevels / pushLevels / or atomic level readers for L/R peak and RMS that are safe for the processor to update lock-free
- Timer cadence capped at 30-60 Hz stated as a named constant
- No audio-thread callbacks on this component; message-thread Timer only for UI refresh
- Include guards / #pragma once and minimal JUCE includes
- Declarations only; no out-of-line method bodies

Do not implement .cpp, SpectrumVisualizer, PluginEditor, or PluginProcessor in this task.
acceptance_criteria: Source/GUI/MeterComponent.h declares class MeterComponent deriving from juce::Component and juce::Timer
Source/GUI/MeterComponent.h declares L/R peak and RMS level inputs or atomics suitable for lock-free processor updates
Source/GUI/MeterComponent.h declares a Timer cadence constant in the 30-60 Hz range
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: call repaint() from any audio-thread API

allowed: declare lock-free or atomic L/R peak and RMS level storage
